nodes.label: Pitfall: Laravel Writes Conflict with Python Pipeline Mid-Transaction
nodes.rationale: Two separate processes writing the same MySQL rows with no distributed lock can flip clip status incorrectly; requires SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / lockForUpdate() and a clear state-transition ownership boundary.

nodes.label: Pitfall: Webhook Receives Duplicate Updates on Server Errors

nodes.norm_label: pitfall: webhook receives duplicate updates on server errors

nodes.label: Pitfall: n8n Still Running Telegram Bot in Parallel After Migration
nodes.rationale: If n8n's Telegram webhook isn't explicitly deregistered before Laravel's is registered, updates route to whichever is registered last, silently breaking the other.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: n8n still running telegram bot in parallel after migration

nodes.label: Pitfall: Content ID Claim Despite Watermark

nodes.label: Pitfall: Blacklist Check Happens Too Late in the Pipeline
